verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents worldwide region deployment with Anycast routing to the nearest server, and Machines that run close to users. It also offers Managed Postgres, so a team could manually pick regions next to its data. However, the evidence is entirely about placing compute near users, not automatically placing compute near backend data. Missing for 10: automatic data-aware placement, documentation on co-locating compute with database regions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of latency gains from data proximity.
